turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm hosting a board game night on Saturday for six people. What should I prepare?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Pick two or three games, one easy, one longer, and maybe a quick party game. Read the rules before they arrive.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good to question it. I still think it's right, though you know your situation best.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good point, I always forget the rules halfway.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Watching a short rules video beforehand helps. For food, go for things that aren't greasy, like crackers, fruit or popcorn.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Greasy fingers on the cards, yeah.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exactly. And keep drinks on a separate small table so nothing gets spilled on the board.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: do a little prize for the winner?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's fun. Something silly works best, like a cheap trophy that gets passed on every game night.
